ActionPlan.description:
The plan of section 9.6. The plan hash (A.4) is taken over `model_dump(mode="json")`, so
equal plans hold every list in one stable order.
ActionPlan.title: ActionPlan

AnswerEvent.description:
The turn closed with an answer. A directive the command layer refuses (an approval, a
rejection, a send) closes this way too, with the reason and no card (7.4, A.11).
AnswerEvent.title: AnswerEvent

artifact_hash.description: The payload hash shown with the draft. Required when the item is a draft or a review that holds a draft, and omitted otherwise. Which item it is, is known to the handler, so the schema leaves the field optional.
artifact_hash.title: Artifact Hash

Assumption.description: One unknown input and the case taken for it, in A.6's condition form.
Assumption.title: Assumption

BlockerDetail.description: What a blocker carries beyond its kind and owner; also the shape of `blockers.detail_json`.
BlockerDetail.title: BlockerDetail

BlockerView.description:
An open blocker. `item_id` is `blockers.id`, the id an `approve` or `reject` names.

The conversation offers the actions for every open item (section 11), so the blocker carries
what its action needs: a pending observation's value (`observation`, required exactly for the
item kind `observation`). The item kind and, for a review, the cause are in `detail`.
BlockerView.title: BlockerView

ChatExchange.description:
An earlier message of the conversation and what it was answered with: the answer, a card's
rationale or an error.
ChatExchange.title: ChatExchange

ChatRequest.description:
One chat turn: the underwriter's message, the lead whose conversation is open when there is
one, and the last exchanges of that conversation, oldest first.
ChatRequest.title: ChatRequest

Citation.description:
What a reference number of one chat turn stands for. `id` is an event id for an `event`, for a
`fact` (the event that recorded it) and for a `reply` (its `reply_received` event), an intent id
for a `message`, and a page key for a `page`.
Citation.title: Citation

CoverageAdjustmentEffect.description: A proposed value for a coverage field; the submitted value stays with the facts.
CoverageAdjustmentEffect.title: CoverageAdjustmentEffect

DraftView.description: One of the lead's intents (A.1). A reply is accepted only for one in state `sent`.
DraftView.title: DraftView

ErrorEvent.description: The turn closed without an answer.
ErrorEvent.title: ErrorEvent

EventMessage.description: The words of a sent request (subject and body) or of a received reply (body only).
EventMessage.title: EventMessage

EventRow.description:
One of a lead's events: its id, type, run mode, actor, simulated time and a summary of its payload.
`item_id` is the underwriter's item a blocker or approval event names (a wait on the producer or on
data is no item), `choice_ids` the choices a question card opened with or the one a ruling
answers, `fact_key` the key a fact event records, `message` the words of a sent request or a
reply, and `lookup` how a `provider_called` row's lookup went; each is None or empty where the
event has none.
EventRow.title: EventRow

FactField.description: A fact key an underwriter may resolve, with the label and answer type the page offers it by.
FactField.title: FactField

FactView.description: An effective fact with its source tag. `p_f` is a fact like any other.
FactView.title: FactView

Item.description:
An open item an underwriter acts on: a review, a question card or an unknown delivery. The
lead's detail carries what its action needs; this row says which lead to open.
Item.title: Item

LeadDetail.description:
`GET /api/leads/{id}`. The rule traces are the plan's (`effects[].trace`,
`declines_on_every_branch`); its open choices and `not_evaluated` notes are the plan's too.
LeadDetail.title: LeadDetail

LookupView.description: How a provider lookup went: its status and, when blocked, the inputs it lacked.
LookupView.title: LookupView

ObligationEffect.description: A post-bind obligation; recorded and never executed.
ObligationEffect.title: ObligationEffect

PlanPage.description: What the lead's stored plan holds for one playbook page.
PlanPage.title: PlanPage

ProposalEvent.description: The turn closed with a card: `GET /api/proposals` holds it.
ProposalEvent.title: ProposalEvent

ProposalView.description: A proposal card (A.1). A command proposal's payload is `{type, payload, rationale}`.
ProposalView.title: ProposalView

QueueRow.description:
One row per lead, in the order the response lists them. The one-sentence summary is
`GET /api/run`'s `summary`, not part of this response.
QueueRow.title: QueueRow

ReplyRequest.description: `POST /api/replies` and the `deliver_reply` payload; the body is capped at `MAX_BODY_CHARACTERS` (A.9).
ReplyRequest.title: ReplyRequest

ReplyResponse.description: Returned after the reply has been read and the lead re-evaluated, or refused.
ReplyResponse.title: ReplyResponse

RuleTrace.description: Either one path or a set of alternatives, never both.
RuleTrace.title: RuleTrace

RunSummary.description:
The one-sentence summary's seven counts (section 11).

`follow_ups_sent` counts every request sent to a producer, in any round. The four waiting
counts count each lead once, by its primary next action: an underwriter review or question, a
producer reply, a data blocker, or an unknown delivery.
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

RunView.description:
`GET /api/run`; also the reply of `POST /api/run/start`. Before a run starts `run_id` and
`sim_now` are null and the counts are zero.
RunView.title: RunView

StepEvent.description: A lookup of the turn has completed: what was read and what it held, in one line.
StepEvent.title: StepEvent

TraceBranch.description: One alternative of a decline on every branch: the cases taken for the unknown inputs and the path that follows.
TraceBranch.title: TraceBranch

schema.title: Response List Items Api Items Get
Response List Leads Api Leads Get
Response List Proposals Api Proposals Get
